text:
maria: Heads-up 5m — I'm putting together the PRD for Dedicated fleet sizing + SLA experiments. Need quick alignment on pass/fail gates, experiments, and who runs each run. Goal: a clear launch checklist for reserved GPU pools.
kevin: Sounds good. Suggest we split workloads into: short-chat (<=512 tokens), medium-convo (512-2k), and long-gen (2k+). For short-chat I'm leaning toward p95 <= 120ms on committed capacity. Medium and long measured by sustained tokens/sec and tail latency windows.
eli: Perf context: internal benches show: MPT-7B-8bit ~220-350 tok/s on A100-80, Llama2-13B-quant ~70-140 tok/s depending on seq len. Recommend sizing commit = estimated peak / per-gpu tok/s * 1.6 headroom factor to cover noisy neighbors.
sara: Autoscale policy prototype:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 30
  triggers:
    - name: queue_depth
      threshold: 40
      action: scale_up +3
    - name: p95_ms
      threshold: 110
      action: scale_up +1
  cool_down: 45s
  max_scale_rate: 4/min
```
Will add a ramp-down cooldown to avoid oscillation.
deploy-bot: perf-run/902 completed on staging: short-chat at 75% target, observed p95=118ms, p99 spikes correlate with cold-kv misses.
kevin: Edge cases: KV-cache miss storms; long-seq OOMs that temporarily reduce effective replicas; noisy tenant saturating NVLink. Need graceful-degrade: prefer model-fallback (to a smaller variant) for 95th+ length requests and queue-based backpressure for extreme bursts.
maria: Proposed acceptance gates (draft):
1) Short-chat: at committed throughput, p95 <= 120ms and error-rate <0.3% over 24h.
2) Medium-convo: median latency within 25% of estimate and p95 within 40% during sustained windows.
3) Long-gen: sustained tokens/sec >= 80% of sizing estimate for >=95% of 5-min windows.
4) Autoscale resilience: after 2x sustained load spike, restoration of full throughput within 25s without >1% error-rate.
5) Canary: pilot with 3 customers for 72h, end-to-end failures <1% and no P0 incidents.
kevin: Measurement infra to build: per-request token counts, per-replica p50/p95/p99, queue length histogram, KV-cache hit ratio, OOM/restarts counter, and SLA billing counters. Need a launch dashboard for signoff.
eli: Tests I'll run: production-trace replay (multi-tenant), mixed-workload stress (chat + embeddings bursts), chaos (kill 30% of replicas randomly), cache-cold ramp (measure warmup delta), and long-seq saturation. I can own the replay harness and runbook.
sara: I'll own canary plan + rollback playbook. Proposal: staged canary -> 10% traffic, 6h -> 30%, 24h -> 100% if metrics stable. Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 200ms, error-rate >2%, or >1 OOM/restart/min. Also proposing a "burst-credit" feature: short 60s windows of excess tokens with gradual throttling when credits depleted.
maria: Let's capture a few hard edge-case behaviors to document in PRD:
- Cache-miss storms: documented mitigation = pre-warming, cache heatmap monitoring, and prefilling for pilot customers.
- Very long single-request sequences: enforce soft max length or route to dedicated long-gen pool with lower p95 guarantees.
- Partial GPU failures: automatic replica reprovision + temporary routing to cold fallback model.
- Billing mismatch windows: when we've throttled, expose clear counter to customer portal.
kevin: Also add acceptance test for multi-tenant fairness: run 5 tenants with skewed traffic and make sure no single tenant consumes >40% of committed throughput for >10m without alert + mitigation.
maria: Rough timeline & owners: Maria finalize PRD draft by Mon 10/07; Kevin deliver updated perf estimates Wed 10/09; Eli run synthetic + chaos tests Thu 10/10; Sara deliver canary schedule + rollback by Fri 10/11. After tests, we'll run a 72h pilot with select customers.
eli: I'll attach perf run artifacts and a short README for how to replay traces. Will post links when runs complete.
sara: I'll draft a minimal dashboard view (p95, p99, queue, kv-hit, errors) for signoff and include playbook entries for oncall.
maria: OK locking in acceptance criteria barring objections. I'll post the PRD link when it's in the docs repo. If anyone sees a missing test or a metric we should enforce, flag it here. :rocket:
